propositions: Two regex patterns and one scope extractor key on '## Success Criteria' heading, making it load-bearing and blocking store migration verification until changed to '## Acceptance Criteria'
The clarity-score bonus for epics must be repointed from Success Criteria to Acceptance Criteria to maintain score neutrality (6 points) and avoid regression across 108 migrated real tickets
All test fixtures embedding '## Success Criteria' must be updated to use '## Acceptance Criteria' with converted checklist items or removed if both headings are present
The epic branch in both _clarity_score copies must remain textually in lockstep to preserve the module-documented invariant
A new contract test must prove the heading collapse by demonstrating epics with Acceptance Criteria pass both clarity-check and check-ac gates and score exactly 6 points
